name: Full Kiss
source:
Masaharu started at his new school hopeful of getting a girlfriend. A year later, his dream appeared to have been merely a delusion. However, the falling cherry blossoms signal the beginning of a new year and perhaps, a chance for his dream to finally come true.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/03/01/march-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
正治开始了他的新学校，希望能找到一个女朋友。一年后，他的梦想似乎只是一个幻想。然而，飘落的樱花预示着新的一年的开始，或许也是他梦想成真的机会。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/03/01/march-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
